Game Overview

In Moon Bridge, the core idea is straightforward: escape gravity and soar skyward in Moon Bridge, an addictive arcade adventure where timing is everything. Construct bridges to climb ever higher towards the moon, mastering precision and patience. Challenge yourself in a visually captivating space setting, aiming for that high score as difficulty intensifies.
